Adm. Arleigh A. Burke

Chief of Naval Operations · 1955–1961 · at the opening, 1955-11-01

CNO on the opening date, two months in. Served three terms; the carriers that flew Rolling Thunder were his fleet’s design.

The office

The Joint Staff, the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia. The Chairman’s office is on the E-ring, second floor, river side; the Chiefs meet in the “Tank”, Room 2E924, and from 1972 in the Gold Room next to it.
